title: b7z9.16(a): wire DAO timing into Rust RplStack TX path
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16 (spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019: initial DAO random 0-2s after joining; retry 4/8/16s exponential backoff; refresh 900s = 30-min soft lifetime / 2). Wire rust/lichen-rpl/src/dao_timing.rs exports (DAO_INITIAL_DELAY_MIN/MAX_MS:9-12, DAO_RETRY_DELAYS_MS=[4000,8000,16000]:15, DAO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS=900:27, DaoRetryBackoff:196, DaoRefreshTimer:122) into the rust/lichen-node RplStack DAO TX path (after build_signed_dao / send_dao — find callers via grep). Runtime must: schedule initial DAO 0-2s after DODAG join, drive retries through DaoRetryBackoff, re-emit via DaoRefreshTimer. Keep dao_timing.rs constants/functions as the single oracle — do not duplicate constants. Unit tests: drive the TX path with a fake/controllable clock asserting the three behaviors (exact boundaries from constants). Independently landable; Python and C mirrors are sibling children.
